summary_en: 150,000 shares (upper limit) to be acquired via off-exchange (立会外) block transaction on 2026-08-19 at Fukuoka exchange closing price of ¥2,779/share. Results to be published after 08:50 JST execution window. Part of broader ¥1.1B / 460,000-share authorization announced 2026-08-18.
title_en: Notice of Self-Share Acquisition via Off-Exchange (Taikai-Gai) Block Transaction
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-18, Miyazaki Taiyo Bank's board resolved to execute a specific block acquisition under the broader share buyback authorization announced the same day. The bank will acquire up to 150,000 shares of common stock via off-exchange (立会外) block transaction on 2026-08-19 at the Fukuoka Securities Exchange. The transaction is priced at the closing price (including final special quotation) from 2026-08-18, which was ¥2,779 per share. The purchase order is valid only during the designated trading window (08:50 JST) and will be matched against sell orders received during that time. Execution results will be announced immediately after the trading window closes. The block is part of the larger authorization of up to 460,000 shares and ¥1.1 billion announced on the same date (2026-08-18). The filing notes that partial or full non-execution is possible depending on market conditions.
